speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I am Dr. Agent; since you are a newborn, I will be speaking with your parent or guardian. To begin our assessment, how old is the infant, and have you noticed any fever, unusual crying, or changes in feeding habits recently?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Syphilis.

Given the lack of prenatal care and immunization history, the infant is at high risk for congenital infections. I need to proceed with specific screening. REQUEST TEST: VDRL (RPR) on infant serum and urine, and request a Full Blood Count. REQUEST IMAGES: Physical examination photos of the skin for rash or snuffles.
